principle: A current-race feature is confirmatory-eligible only if its value and availability are frozen at or before the prediction snapshot. Historical features must use source rows strictly earlier than the target race date.

new_machine_evidence.finding: The exact JVD parsed source co-resides with final_finish/final_odds/final_popularity/payout fields and raw header date-like behavior is post-race. Current jockey/weight/bodyweight/abnormal/starters from this source are therefore not snapshot-safe.

GREEN_HISTORICAL_ONLY_IF_STRICT_DATE: historical aggregates reconstructed with history_date < target_race_date
unlock_requirements: Acquire a genuinely pre-race source/event record for current-race features.
Preserve acquisition/update/source timestamp for each feature record.
Hash and archive raw snapshot before feature extraction/model execution.
Do not backfill later cancellation/exclusion/bodyweight/track/weather state into an earlier snapshot.

trial_policy.reason: DEV v2-v5 produced small unstable gains and current JVD state lacks snapshot provenance.
trial_policy.next_trial_requires: Race-time Snapshot Gate V2 unlock first, then a new preregistered DEV family with external hash/timestamp anchor.
